_comment_env: DO NOT put SACRED_OVERRIDE_FILES or CLAUDE_HUMAN_OVERRIDE in this file. On 2026-09-02 an env block here was used to carry an in-chat authorization to .claude/hooks/path-allowlist.py (which reads the var from its own process env). It worked, and it was the wrong place: this file IS TRACKED IN GIT (added 102bb0d; it is not in .gitignore), so a standing override here is one `git add -A` away from being pushed, and until removed it silently disarms the Tier 1 guard for every later session on this machine. The correct channel is the megaloop launch line, which scopes the grant to one process for one run: see the launch command in docs/handoff_template.md and .memory/_inbox/human_needed.md. Removed 2026-09-02 the same day it was added; `python eval/run_tier1.py` reconfirms the guard blocks.
